data.title: Energy & Utilities
data.tagline: Reliable supply, visible losses, and a credible path to lower emissions.
data.overview: Energy and utility operators carry two mandates at once: keep supply secure today and decarbonise over time. We instrument the network, improve control, and prioritise capital so both mandates use the same evidence.

challenges.title: Ageing infrastructure
challenges.description: Protection and control systems outlive their supportability.

challenges.title: Outage risk
challenges.description: Failure modes are known but not quantified at the feeder or asset level.

challenges.title: Decarbonisation pressure
challenges.description: Targets exist without a sequenced, measurable investment plan.

solutions.title: Infrastructure Engineering
solutions.tagline: Resilient electrical, utility, and facility systems for critical operations.
solutions.overview: From load studies to commissioning, we engineer the physical systems that keep production and services running. Our work is judged by resilience, maintainability, and a handover package the client's own team can operate.

image.alt: Container cranes above stacked shipping containers

solutions.title: Digital Transformation
solutions.tagline: A practical route from fragmented systems to a connected operation.
solutions.overview: Transformation fails when it starts with technology. We help leadership sequence change around a clear operating problem, then deliver the data, systems, and habits that make the change durable.

solutions.title: System Integration
solutions.tagline: One accountable team across vendors, protocols, and sites.
solutions.overview: We take responsibility for the seams. Meridian coordinates vendors, designs the integration layer, tests the whole system, and stays accountable when something does not behave as specified.
